postings.title: Senior Designer
postings.description:
SENIOR ART DIRECTOR, MARKETING



ABOUT NOVO

Small businesses are the backbone of the US economy, comprising almost half of the GDP and the private workforce. Yet, big banks don't provide the access, assistance and modern tools that owners need to successfully grow their business.

We started Novo to challenge the status quo—we're on a mission to increase the GDP of the modern entrepreneur by creating the go-to banking platform for small businesses (SMBs). Novo is flipping the script of the banking world, and we're excited to lead the small business banking revolution.

At Novo, we're here to help entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups and SMBs achieve their financial goals by empowering them with an operating system that makes business banking as easy as iOS. We developed modern bank accounts and tools to help save time and increase cash flow. Our unique product integrations enable easy access to tracking payments, transferring money internationally, managing business transactions and more. We've made a big impact in a short amount of time, helping thousands of organizations access powerfully simple business banking.

Why Novo?

 - 250,000+ business customers using the platform

 - $30B+ in transactions processed

 - Profitable, with $170M raised to date

 - Backed by firms including Valar Ventures, Crosslink Capital, Stripes, BoxGroup, RRE Ventures, and Notable Capital

 - Global team with offices in New York, India, and Colombia

 - We work with modern tools technologies, of course.. AI

 - We provide learning and development budgets to help you grow and bond with your team


THE ROLE

Novo's brand needs someone to own it. We're hiring a Senior Designer / Art Director to set the creative vision and direction for the brand and lead our digital creative across marketing: paid, owned, and everything in between.

You'll decide how Novo looks, feels and shows up everywhere a business owner meets us. You'll turn business goals into campaigns that stop the scroll, convert prospects, and make customers proud to bank with us.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real influence. You won't manage a team, but you'll be the creative lead for marketing and the standard-bearer for the brand across the company. You'll work closely with our Director of Integrated Marketing and Senior Copywriter, and with growth, lifecycle and product marketing partners.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



SET THE CREATIVE VISION FOR THE NOVO BRAND

 - Own Novo's creative direction and visual identity, and evolve it as the company grows

 - Define the brand's look, feel and point of view, and hold the bar across every touchpoint

 - Build and maintain a scalable visual system and brand guidelines that keep marketing consistent while still pushing creative boundaries

 - Present work to leadership and stakeholders, and argue for creative decisions with clarity and conviction


LEAD DIGITAL CREATIVE ACROSS MARKETING

 - Lead creative for campaigns across paid (paid social, display, video, SEM) and owned channels (web, landing pages, email, lifecycle, organic social)

 - Concept and deliver high-impact work for brand, growth and product marketing, from brief to final assets

 - Design and iterate on landing pages, campaign visuals, ad creative and brand content tied to measurable results

 - Create motion and video for ads, product launches and social

 - Partner with growth marketing to produce, test and optimize ad creative at scale, balancing craft with velocity

 - Use generative AI across the process (ideation, moodboards, variations, production) to move faster without lowering the bar


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - In your first 90 days, you've audited Novo's brand across channels and aligned the team on a clear creative direction

 - Campaigns ship faster, look unmistakably Novo, and beat their performance benchmarks

 - The rest of the company reaches for your brand system and templates by default


MUST HAVE

 - 7–9+ years in design focused on brand, marketing or advertising creative, ideally in tech, fintech or a high-growth startup

 - Experience setting creative direction for a brand, not just executing it

 - A portfolio that shows range: brand campaigns, performance ads, web/landing pages, and motion

 - Expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro)

 - Strong motion design and video editing for social, paid and product storytelling

 - A sharp eye for typography, layout, color and composition, and the ability to explain why something works

 - Experience partnering with growth and performance teams to produce and iterate on ad creative

 - Fluency with generative AI design tools (e.g. Figma AI, Midjourney, Firefly, Runway, ChatGPT/Claude, Fal, etc..) and a clear view of when AI is and isn't the right tool

 - Comfort moving fast in a startup while holding a high bar for quality

 - Confident communicator who presents ideas well, gives useful feedback, and pushes back thoughtfully


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience leading a brand refresh or rebrand

 - Fintech or SMB-focused brand experience

 - Art directing photo or video shoots, or working with freelancers and agencies

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, Banking
postings.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Novo is a venture-backed fintech that simplifies banking for small businesses. Since our Fall 2018 beta launch, we've expanded offerings from free checking accounts and debit cards to lending products, business tools (invoices, bookkeeping, and more), and integrations.Today http://integrations.Today, Novo is a powerfully simple banking platform that serves over 250,000 small businesses. In addition to providing smart tools built for entrepreneurs to better run and grow their businesses, Novo has processed billions in transactions in partnership with a number of established banking partners.

Our vision is to be the go-to platform serving small businesses – from launch to everyday – so business owners can focus on growing, while Novo provides seamless money movement, money storage, and access to capital. We'd like to look back 5–10 years from now and know that we helped new generations of small businesses succeed because of the work we did at Novo. Novo raised $170 million in venture capital and is backed by leading investors, including Stripes, Valar Ventures, Crosslink Capital, and Notable Capital (formerly GGV). Learn more at https://www.novo.co https://www.novo.co.



ROLE DESCRIPTION

Novo is seeking a highly experienced and motivated product manager to own and scale our core banking experience — the accounts, money movement, cards, and program infrastructure that power banking for over 250,000 small businesses. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, usability, and depth of the products at the heart of Novo, supporting our rapidly expanding customer base and business operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product leader who can set product direction for complex, regulated financial products, partner closely with Engineering, Design, Risk, and Compliance, and work hand-in-hand with banking partners to ship reliable, secure, high-quality experiences within a dynamic, regulated fintech environment.



RESPONSIBILITIES


PRODUCT STRATEGY & LEADERSHIP

 - Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Novo's core banking products, including deposit accounts, money movement, cards, and the underlying program infrastructure.

 - Develop a clear point of view for each product — defining who it serves, what value it delivers, and why it resonates — so Novo serves the right small businesses deeply rather than building for everyone and no one.

 - Serve as a key product partner to the executive team, translating company objectives and customer insight into a prioritized banking roadmap.

 - Balance near-term delivery with the platform and product depth investments needed to support long-term growth and retention.


BANKING PRODUCTS & MONEY MOVEMENT

 - Own the end-to-end experience for account opening, funding, deposits, and money-movement flows (ACH, wires, transfers, bill pay, and card transactions), partnering with Engineering on the ledger, payments rails, and card systems beneath them.

 - Define and improve the products that drive deposits, money storage, and money movement, deepening engagement and increasing the number of Novo products each customer uses.

 - Partner with the team to evaluate and improve partner-bank and program economics, ensuring the products we ship are both valuable to customers and sustainable for the business.

 - Translate complex regulatory, banking-partner, and operational requirements into intuitive, simple experiences for small business owners.


DISCOVERY, EXECUTION & QUALITY

 - Run a rigorous discovery process grounded in customer research, usage data, and cohort analysis to identify the highest-impact opportunities across the banking experience.

 - Favor rigorous, cohort-based analysis over surface-level correlation when evaluating performance and prioritizing investment, while staying comfortable acting on directional data when speed and urgency demand it.

 - Write clear specs, define success metrics, and partner with Engineering and Design to ship reliable, secure, high-quality features on a predictable cadence.

 - Monitor product performance and key metrics, distinguish signal from noise, and drive timely iteration when results diverge from expectations.


RELIABILITY, RISK & COMPLIANCE

 - Partner with Engineering, InfoSec, and Operations to ensure banking products meet the reliability, availability, and data-integrity bar required in a regulated financial environment.

 - Embed risk, fraud, security, and regulatory requirements into the product process from the start, partnering with Risk, Compliance, and Legal to ship products responsibly.

 - Support the reporting and product controls required by banking partners, regulators, and internal stakeholders.

 - Treat trust as a first-class product requirement, recognizing that banking and financial products demand a higher threshold of trust than any consumer app.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP

 - Partner closely with Engineering and Design leadership to align on roadmap, scope, and sequencing, and to turn product strategy into reliable delivery.

 - Collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to set targets, track KPIs, and translate strategy into operating plans.

 - Manage product relationships and integrations with banking partners and key third-party vendors, navigating the technical and regulatory requirements inherent to a fintech company.

 - Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, from individual contributors to the executive team and board.


STRATEGIC PLANNING & EXECUTION

 - Contribute to strategic planning for future product needs and the broader company roadmap.

 - Define and track the product metrics that matter, including activation, engagement, retention, multi-product adoption, and reliability, holding the organization accountable to outcomes.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, with experience owning complex, technical, or platform products (preferably in fintech, financial services, banking, or payments).

 - Demonstrable track record of shipping reliable, customer-facing products in a high-growth, regulated environment, ideally involving money movement, payments, cards, deposits, or other financial infrastructure.

 - Strong understanding of banking and fintech fundamentals, including how accounts, money movement, cards, deposits, and partner-bank and program infrastructure work together.

 - Proven ability to partner with and influence Engineering and Design, write clear specs, and ship high-quality software on a predictable cadence.

 - Strong analytical skills and fluency with product and cohort data, with the judgment to know when data is conclusive versus directional.

 - Experience working with Risk, Compliance, and Legal to ship products within regulatory constraints, and a track record of treating security, trust, and reliability as core product requirements.

 - Strong product sense and the ability to give products a clear point of view and value proposition for a defined customer.

 - Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional initiatives and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, data-driven approach to product.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

 - Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or relevant technical background preferred.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager, SMB Platform
postings.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Novo is a venture-backed fintech that simplifies banking for small businesses. Since our Fall 2018 beta launch, we've expanded offerings from free checking accounts and debit cards to lending products, business tools (invoices, bookkeeping, and more), and integrations.

Today, Novo is a powerfully simple banking platform that serves over 250,000 small businesses. In addition to providing smart tools built for entrepreneurs to better run and grow their businesses, Novo has processed billions in transactions in partnership with a number of established banking partners.

Our vision is to be the go-to platform serving small businesses – from launch to everyday – so business owners can focus on growing, while Novo provides seamless money movement, money storage, and access to capital. We'd like to look back 5–10 years from now and know that we helped new generations of small businesses succeed because of the work we did at Novo.

Novo raised $170 million in venture capital and is backed by leading investors, including Stripes, Valar Ventures, Crosslink Capital, and Notable Capital (formerly GGV). Learn more at https://www.novo.co.



ROLE DESCRIPTION

Novo is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the platform surface area that connects, activates, and deepens value for small businesses in their first 90 days and beyond. This role spans our DDA onboarding to funding activation funnel, invoice workflow, external integrations ecosystem — three interconnected surfaces that together determine whether a new Novo customer becomes an engaged, transacting one. The role will also explore how to apply AI to enhance how SMBs interact with Novo. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product leader who combines platform and tooling depth with a growth mindset: someone who can own complex product workflows end-to-end, run rigorous experimentation, and is comfortable getting their hands dirty in LLMs. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of product tooling, ecosystem connectivity, and customer activation.



RESPONSIBILITIES



DDA ONBOARDING & ACTIVATION FUNNEL

 - Own the DDA application, signup, and account-opening funnel — driving activation in the first 90 days of a customer's tenure by reducing friction, improving conversion, and getting customers to their first meaningful transaction faster.

 - Run a steady cadence of onboarding and activation experiments using tools like LaunchDarkly, managing incentives, in-product moments, and lifecycle prompts that create compelling reasons for customers to deepen their engagement with Novo.


INVOICE WORKFLOW & TOOLING

 - Own the end-to-end invoice experience creation and scheduling, PDF generation, branding and customization, reminders, dispute handling, payment collection via multiple rails, and reconciliation driving adoption as a core SMB financial tool.

 - Identify and ship improvements that make the invoice workflow more intelligent: smart reminders, automated reconciliation, AI-assisted invoice creation, and workflow automation that reduces manual effort for busy business owners.


INTEGRATIONS & CONNECTED PLATFORM

 - Own Novo's integration ecosystem across revenue (e.g., Stripe, Square), accounting (QuickBooks, Xero), payroll (Gusto), and utilities (Slack, Zapier) deepening existing integrations from basic data sync to richer, bidirectional workflows.

 - Lead the vision for a Novo API strategy that enables LLM and third-party connectivity, allowing customers to query their banking and financial data through external AI assistants and business tools, while identifying new integration opportunities that address core SMB financial workflows.


EXPERIMENTATION & DATA

 - Design, run, and scale a rigorous experimentation program across the platform — covering onboarding flows, invoice tooling, and integration adoption — with clear hypotheses, measurement plans, and ownership of outcomes.

 - Define and own the platform KPIs that matter — activation rate, integration adoption, invoice volume, 90-day retention — building and maintaining the analytics instrumentation needed to measure the funnel end-to-end and give leadership a shared, realistic view of platform health.


AI-ENHANCED CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

 - Apply AI to enhance how SMBs interact with Novo: smart invoice tooling, automated transaction categorization, agentic financial workflows, and personalized platform experiences that reduce the cognitive load of running a small business.

 - Defying and leading the product vision for Novo's AI integration strategy (should we build an external API, agentic workflows?) while ensuring AI-driven features meet financial services privacy and regulatory standards.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP & EXECUTION

 - Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing to ship platform improvements and productionalize experimental wins into durable, scalable features — running a consistent operating cadence that surfaces friction early and optimizes for the global maximum.

 - Communicate progress, priorities, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders and leadership, with the intellectual honesty to flag when a bet isn't working and redirect accordingly.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Demonstrated track record of owning and shipping platform, tooling, or integration products in fintech, financial services, or SMB-focused technology with the ability to define a compelling product vision for your area, translate it into a prioritized roadmap, and build buy-in across engineering, design, and leadership.

 - Deep familiarity with SMB customer needs, financial workflows invoicing, accounting, payments, cash flow  and the small business software ecosystem; recognized as a domain resource who can guide teams on what matters and why.

 - Proven ability to turn customer insight into product decisions: experience running discovery, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative signals, and making prioritization tradeoffs that are defensible with data and grounded in user reality.

 - Strong data proficiencyable to write clear measurement plans, instrument funnels, evaluate experiment results, and distinguish conclusive from directional signals  with hands-on experience running A/B tests using modern tooling (e.g., LaunchDarkly, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar).

 - Technical acumen sufficient to partner effectively with engineering: comfort with API concepts, integration architecture, and the ability to write clear specs and make informed tradeoff decisions without being the one writing the code.

 - Practical experience using AI tools to accelerate product work generating content, analyzing data, prototyping features  with sound judgment about where AI adds real value and where it introduces risk, particularly in a regulated financial services context.

 - Experience shipping in a regulated environment, working with Risk, Compliance, and Legal to meet security, privacy, and financial services standards.

 - Strong communication and cross-functional stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to leadership and aligning teams around platform decisions in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

 - Bachelor's degree required; analytical, technical, or business background preferred.

 - We work with very new technologies and architecture patterns

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition across Google, Meta, and other programmatic channels. You'll be the person who knows exactly where every dollar of budget is going and why. You’ll be running the day-to-day of our paid programs, digging into the numbers, and constantly finding the next lever to pull for efficiency and growth.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role for someone who loves being in the platforms as much as they love the spreadsheet next to them. You'll be directly working on the top company priority of driving new customer growth for our core products.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the paid program execution, end to end

 - Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Demand Gen, Mobile UAC), Meta, and other programmatic/paid social channels

 - Optimize daily budget allocation across channels and campaigns, and make the case for shifting spend based on performance

 - Set up and maintain tracking, UTMs, and conversion measurement so every dollar can be tied back to a result

Live in the numbers

 - Monitor campaign performance daily against targets (CAC, ROAS, CPA, signups) and report on results on a recurring cadence

 - Analyze trends, spot what's working and what isn't, and turn that into a clear optimization plan (bid adjustments, audience changes, budget shifts, creative swaps)

 - Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that give stakeholders visibility into program performance

Test and optimize relentlessly

 - Run a structured testing agenda across audiences, creative, bidding strategies, and landing pages

 - Partner with design and creative to brief, launch, and iterate on ad creative at scale

 - Proactively flag underperforming areas of the program and bring a plan to fix them

Partner cross-functionally

 - Work with Strategy & Analytics to make sure tracking, attribution, and reporting are accurate and trusted

 - Collaborate with design and lifecycle partners to keep paid creative and messaging aligned with the broader marketing calendar

 - Communicate campaign performance and budget decisions clearly to stakeholders outside of paid media


MUST HAVE

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience running paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, with exposure to other programmatic channels

 - A track record of owning budget allocation and pacing, and making data-backed calls on where to shift spend

 - Strong analytical skills: comfortable in spreadsheets, pulling your own reports, and translating data into a clear next step

 - Familiarity with using AI to build custom analyses and workflows

 - Sharp attention to detail across campaign setup, tracking, budgets, and reporting; you catch the small errors before they become expensive ones

 - Experience with campaign and conversion tracking fundamentals (UTMs, pixels, conversion APIs, GA4 or similar)

 - A self-starter mentality: comfortable driving a testing roadmap and daily campaign management with minimal oversight

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain performance and recommendations to non-paid-media stakeholders

 - Experience working cross-functionally with design, analytics, and growth teams

 - Fluent in English


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in fintech, startup, or another high-growth environment

 - Familiarity with additional programmatic/DSP platforms (e.g., The Trade Desk) or paid social beyond Meta (TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit)

 - Experience with Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or similar BI tools for building performance dashboards

Role Summary

The Senior Manager, Customer Support & Success is the strategic owner of Novo's most critical 1:1 customer touchpoints - from complex escalations and collections recovery to a proactive customer success motion you’ll get to build from scratch. This is a player-coach role: you will lead a small, high-performing team while staying close to the work yourself. You will operate with significant autonomy, bring consistency and customer obsession, and shape what this function looks like two to three years from now.


About the Role



ESCALATIONS & COLLECTIONS — RAISE THE BAR

 - Lead escalation specialists and collections & recovery agents handling Novo's most complex, high-stakes issues

 - Collaborate with partners to drive collection performance through data and performance metrics

 - Define and continuously improve escalation runbooks, SLAs, and closed-loop resolution processes

 - Surface recurring issue trends and translate them into structured, actionable feedback for Enablement, Product and Engineering

 - Use data and customer insights to drive closed-loop resolution processes and proactive outbound campaigns

 - Lead collections execution with care: own how recovery work is done and how it lands with customers, delivering against targets


CUSTOMER OBSESSION

 - Own the model for great Novo support experiences - the framework our frontline is held to.

 - Bring the standard to life through partnership: work with Enablement to turn it into training, rubrics, and QA, and with Workforce & Vendor Operations to deliver it consistently across our BPO frontline.

 - Care deeply about the customer experience and know how to balance advocacy for the customer, with good internal judgement and prioritization.

 - Turn recurring friction into action: surface trends and translate them into structured feedback that improves the product and the frontline experience.

 - Lead, coach and enable the team, set clear priorities and expectations that focus on our customers and CX

 - Measure the retention your teams influence - the saves, recovery, and at-risk relationships your team touches and grow it as the motion matures

 - Lead high-value retention plays directly, stepping in personally on at-risk relationships that need senior judgment.

 - Tie what we learn from reactive support tickets and design proactive outbound campaigns in partnership with Marketing, Growth and other stakeholder teams

 - Partner with Marketing, Product, Enablement and Support Operations stakeholders to drive a consistent, brand-aligned quality standards

 - Define which customer moments require human empathy and ensure seamless handoffs from automated to human support

 - Partner across CustOps teams to build scalable experiences based on customer segmentation

 - Partner with Enablement to represent the frontline perspective in product launches, ensuring we’re building the right customer experiences

 - Build feedback loops that continuously inform training, tooling, and process improvements across BPO and internal teams


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

 - Partner with internal Customer Operations leads, Marketing, Compliance, Product, and Engineering across the full customer lifecycle

 - Provide executive-ready reporting on product friction, customer experience quality, risk trends, and customer sentiment with clear recommendations, not just observations

 - Manage dependencies and escalations proactively; keep programs on track without needing to be asked

 - Work cross functionally to solve big problems, with the ability to break down ambiguous issues, isolate root causes and drive investigations



Requirements for the Role

 - 6+ years in Customer Success, Support leadership, RevOps, Client experience, CX Enablement, with meaningful time in a builder or scale-up environment

 - Background in fintech, banking, lending or SMB financial services strongly preferred — you understand the stakes of financial products for small business owners

 - Demonstrated experience building CS or CX programs from the ground up in a mid-maturity organization, not only optimizing what already exists

 - Proven impact on retention metrics: NRR, CSAT, churn, or equivalent business outcomes

 - Solid understanding of customer health, segmentation, retention and customer lifecycle

 - Strong analytical instincts - you can pull apart customer data, identify meaningful signals, and generate insights that drive decisions, not just dashboards

 - Exceptional empathy - you advocate for the human experience in an automated environment and model that standard for your team

 - Sharp operator - you translate customer friction into structured process improvements with measurable outcomes

 - Builder's mindset - You have a bias for action and are energized by ambiguity, able to create clarity and frameworks where none exist, with a focus 2–3 years out, not just the next sprint

 - People developer - you invest in growing your team, create stretch opportunities, and think about succession even when the team is small

 - Collaborative by nature - you build coalitions and define winning in terms of shared outcomes across partner teams

 - Experience with CX tools including CRMs like Kustomer, Jira, BI tools


What Success Looks Like

ABOUT NOVO

Small businesses are the backbone of the US economy - nearly half of GDP and the private workforce, yet big banks don't give owners the access, assistance, or modern tools they need to grow. We started Novo to change that. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the modern entrepreneur by building the go-to banking platform for small businesses.

Novo is a fintech, not a bank. We give entrepreneurs, freelancers, and SMBs an operating system for their money: no-fee business checking, debit and credit cards, loans and funding, payments across every rail (ACH, wires, FedNow), invoicing, bill pay, expense management, and integrations with the tools they already run their business on. We've helped hundreds of thousands of businesses get powerfully simple banking, and we're just getting started.



WHY NOVO? 

 - A mission-driven team building for the people big banks pretend don't exist

 - Real ownership: we make decisions that affect real businesses every day, and we trust people to act on that

 - A flat culture where ideas win on merit; hierarchy is not authority

 - Modern stack, modern tooling, and a team that takes AI seriously as part of how we work

 - Competitive salary and other benefits for every full-time employee

 - Offices in NYC and India
   


ROLE SUMMARY:

We are looking for a Senior KYC Analyst who understands how to ensure that our platform can continue operating in an efficient manner while minimizing downside losses and reducing friction in the onboarding process. If you're passionate about working for a revolutionary early-stage startup, poised for rapid growth and expansion then we want to chat. Are you ready to revolutionize the small business banking industry with us?



ABOUT THE ROLE:

 - Understand and manage KYC and AML processes

 - Support the origination and in-life management of deposits by handling the Customer/Enhanced Due Diligence during on-boarding and in-life periodic reviews.

 - Process all applications through a workflow system effectively, within agreed SLAs and goals, and in compliance with company policies and procedures.

 - Perform due diligence checks on prospective and existing customers, such as requesting KYC information and documentation.

 - Conduct enhanced due diligence on high risk customers, including evaluation of client responses to sources of wealth and intended use of account.

 - Investigate identified suspicious clients generated by the screening system, such as WorldCheck and OFAC list.

 - Analyze the AML/CFT risk of Politically Exposed Persons (PEP), adverse information, business exposure in high risk & sanctioned countries and escalate the issues to the Legal Team for approval.

 - Identify, monitor, evaluate and address customer account actions to address potential risk, fraud or suspicious activity.

 - Follow internal policy and procedures when dealing with account related suspicious activity.

 - Cross reference multiple databases for potential undesirable client matches.
   


REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE:

 - 3-5 years experience working in KYC/compliance related role in the financial services/banking industry 

 - Background working in U.S. markets, in a fintech/tech company, or both. 

 - Comfortable working in the US Shift

 - Deep domain expertise in end-to-end KYC and KYB due diligence, supported by a strong operational understanding of sanctions screening, financial crime risk mitigation and BSA/AML compliances.

 - Experience with Screening/Data mining and using different search engines in prior role.

 - Proficient in MIS, Understanding Data sensitivity, MS Office, with strong Excel skills (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data formatting and Understanding Dashboards)

 - An interest in financial crime and idea of digging deeper, looking into customer behaviors and identifying key characteristics of fraudulent users. 

 - Work on process improvements, conducting training and develop standard operating procedures

 - Ability to oversee critical analytics projects from end to end independently. 

 - Ability to think outside the box, work with limited data, and find solutions to unorthodox problems.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities; focused on getting things done in a highly organized way.

 - Ability to work cross-departmentally, without the need for extensive hierarchical corporate structure

 -  An inquisitive and highly detailed oriented work ethic
   
   What happens once you've submitted your application

 - Step 1: Application Screening

 - Step 2: Recruiter Call (30 mins)

 - Step 3: Hiring Manager Interview

 - Step 4: Technical Assessment (2–3 Rounds)

 - Step 5: Offer & Compensation Discussion
   
   How We Work
   Novo's values shape how this role operates day to day:

 - Run for the bus. When you see something that needs fixing, you fix it. You don't wait for a ticket.

 - Hierarchy is not authority. The best idea wins regardless of who had it — including when it isn't yours.

 - Assume best intention. Hard weeks and mistakes happen. We give grace to each other and to ourselves.

 - Intellectual honesty. We own our mistakes, say so before doubling down, and lead by example.

Novo values diversity as a core tenant of the work we do and the businesses we serve. We are an equal opportunity employer, indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other protected characteristic.

postings.description:
ABOUT NOVO

Small businesses are the backbone of the US economy — nearly half of GDP and the private workforce — yet big banks don't give owners the access, assistance, or modern tools they need to grow. We started Novo to change that. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the modern entrepreneur by building the go-to banking platform for small businesses.

Novo is a fintech, not a bank. We give entrepreneurs, freelancers, and SMBs an operating system for their money: no-fee business checking, debit and credit cards, loans and funding, payments across every rail (ACH, wires, FedNow), invoicing, bill pay, expense management, and integrations with the tools they already run their business on. We've helped hundreds of thousands of businesses get powerfully simple banking, and we're just getting started.



WHY NOVO?

 - A mission-driven team building for the people big banks pretend don't exist

 - Real ownership: we make decisions that affect real businesses every day, and we trust people to act on that

 - A flat culture where ideas win on merit — hierarchy is not authority

 - Modern stack, modern tooling, and a team that takes AI seriously as part of how we work

 - Competitive salary and stock options for every full-time employee

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Learning and development budget

 - Offices in NYC and India, with Wednesday team lunches that rotate cuisines



THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to be the highest-leverage individual contributor on our product design team. You'll own the hardest, most ambiguous design problems at Novo — the ones that cut across checking, payments, credit, and invoicing, and across web, iOS, and Android — and you'll set the bar for what great looks like for everyone else.

This is not a management role. It is a role with real authority over the quality and coherence of the product. You'll partner directly with product leads, engineering leads, data, and compliance to shape what we build, not just how it looks. You'll multiply the team's output by making the design system, the patterns, and the standards stronger than any one designer could on their own.

You'll know you're succeeding when Novo feels like one product instead of a collection of features, when a small business owner can move money, get paid, and access capital without ever having to think about how banking works underneath, and when other designers ship better work because of the foundations you built.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead design on Novo's most complex problems

 - Own end-to-end design for cross-surface initiatives — onboarding and account opening, money movement, lending and credit, invoicing and getting paid — from problem framing through shipped, measured outcomes

 - Turn ambiguous business goals and regulatory constraints into clear product strategy, information architecture, and interaction models

 - Work upstream with product and engineering leads to shape the roadmap, not just execute it

Set and raise the bar for craft

 - Define what "done well" means for interaction, visual, and content design at Novo, and hold the team (and yourself) to it

 - Run design critique that makes people better and work sharper

 - Ship polished, accessible (WCAG-conformant), production-ready design across web and native mobile

Own the design system

 - Lead the evolution of Novo's design system: tokens, components, patterns, documentation, and the process by which it grows

 - Partner with engineering to keep Figma and production in lockstep, and to retire the inconsistencies that accumulate in a fast-moving product

 - Make the system the default path — faster for designers and engineers to use it than to go around it

Design for a regulated product

 - Work hand-in-hand with Compliance, Risk, and Legal so that disclosures, consent, KYC/KYB, and error states are designed with care rather than bolted on

 - Treat trust as a design surface: security, clarity around fees and terms, and honest handling of edge cases

Use AI as part of the craft

 - Fluency across the AI design stack — Figma AI, Claude/ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code for prototyping, generative tools for exploration — with a clear point of view on where they accelerate the work and where they don't

 - Help the team build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for research synthesis, exploration, prototyping, and documentation

 - Contribute design thinking to Novo's own AI-powered product experiences

Multiply the team

 - Mentor senior and mid-level designers through pairing, critique, and feedback

 - Write and codify the principles, patterns, and playbooks that make good design repeatable at Novo

 - Be the design voice in cross-functional and leadership conversations



MUST HAVE

 - 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 operating at a staff or lead scope — owning cross-team, cross-platform problems as an IC

 - A portfolio of shipped, complex products that shows the full arc: research and problem framing, systems thinking, interaction design, visual polish, and business results

 - Deep experience building and scaling design systems across web and native mobile (iOS and Android)

 - Expert-level Figma, strong prototyping skills, and enough technical fluency to pair effectively with engineers and understand what's cheap versus expensive to build

 - Data fluency: you read funnels, frame experiments, and use quantitative and qualitative signals to make design decisions defensible

 - Experience designing in a regulated environment — fintech, financial services, healthcare, or similar — including disclosures, consent flows, and identity verification

 - Hands-on AI fluency in your daily design work, with sound judgment about when it adds value and when it introduces risk

 - Exceptional communication: you present clearly, give and take hard feedback well, and influence without authority

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and speed, without letting quality slide
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Direct experience designing lending, credit, payments, or business onboarding products

 - Comfort prototyping in code (React, SwiftUI, or similar)

 - Experience designing agentic or AI-assisted product experiences

 - Motion and brand sensibility that can bridge product and marketing design

 - Experience working with distributed teams across time zones
   


HOW WE WORK

Novo's values shape how this role operates day to day:

 - Run for the bus. When you see something that needs fixing, you fix it. You don't wait for a ticket.

 - Hierarchy is not authority. The best idea wins regardless of who had it — including when it isn't yours.

 - Assume best intention. Hard weeks and mistakes happen. We give grace to each other and to ourselves.

 - Intellectual honesty. We own our mistakes, say so before doubling down, and lead by example.

Novo values diversity as a core tenant of the work we do and the businesses we serve. postings.title: Lead Devops Engineer
postings.description:
ABOUT US

Small businesses are the backbone of the US economy, comprising almost half of the GDP and the private workforce. Yet, big banks don’t provide the access, assistance and modern tools that owners need to successfully grow their business.

 

We started Novo to challenge the status quo—we’re on a mission to increase the GDP of the modern entrepreneur by creating the go-to banking platform for small businesses (SMBs). Novo is flipping the script of the banking world, and we’re excited to lead the small business banking revolution.

 

At Novo, we’re here to help entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups and SMBs achieve their financial goals by empowering them with an operating system that makes business banking as easy as iOS. We developed modern bank accounts and tools to help to save time and increase cash flow. Our unique product integrations enable easy access to tracking payments, transferring money internationally, managing business transactions and more. We’ve made a big impact in a short amount of time, helping thousands of organizations access powerfully simple business banking.

 

Why Novo?

 - Novo is a rapidly growing series B fintech startup with a mission-driven team that’s passionate about helping every small business in America

 - Positive, inclusive, supportive culture cheering you on your journey

 - We work with very new technologies and architecture patterns

 - Offices in NYC and India.



About the role: 

Collaborate & Inﬂuence.

Drive technical direction and maintain high code quality through design reviews and code reviews.

Partner with Engineering Managers to plan, scope, and deliver infrastructure projects on time.

Contribute to the DevOps hiring process — including technical assessments and interview panels.

Build strong, trust-based relationships across engineering, product, and security teams.

 

Build & Automate:

Design, build, and own Novo's cloud infrastructure on AWS using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Terragrunt).

Automate everything — scaling, patching, incident response, secrets rotation, and day-2 operations.

Deploy and maintain self-service tooling so both the DevOps team and all of Novo's engineering teams can move faster without bottlenecks.

Implement and evolve Novo's CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for speed, safety, and observability.

Partner with developers to build services aligned with modern design patterns (12-Factor, GitOps).

 

Secure & Observe:

Develop, document, and enforce security policies, protocols, and procedures across all environments (dev, QA, staging, prod).

Implement and manage secure networking connectivity to private resources with a Zero-Trust approach.

Automated TLS certiﬁcate lifecycle management.

Monitor and troubleshoot services using Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, and CloudWatch — and proactively identify gaps in observability coverage.

Design and maintain Nginx conﬁgurations, load balancing, and reverse proxy patterns.

 

Automation, AIOps & Modern Tooling:

Use AI-assisted tools (Google Gemini, LLM-based runbook generation, intelligent alerting) to accelerate infrastructure delivery and reduce toil.

Evaluate and adopt emerging AI DevOps tooling — from AIOps anomaly detection to AI-assisted incident triage.

Build internal AI-augmented automations: auto-remediation scripts, policy-as-code evaluators, and intelligent capacity recommendations.

Champion a culture of "automate before you delegate" — if you're doing something manually twice, it should become a script or workﬂow.

 
 

Requirements for the role:

8+ years in cloud infrastructure, with 3+ years hands-on AWS - owning complex systems end-to-end and driving technical decisions across engineering teams

 

Cloud & Infrastructure:

Deep expertise in AWS services, such as: EC2, EKS, ECS, RDS, Elasticache, S3, IAM, VPC, Route 53, CloudFront.

Expert-level Terraform (Terragrunt a strong plus), able to deﬁne custom internal modules to bootstrap complete solutions.

Conﬁdent managing multi-account AWS environments.

Strong Linux systems knowledge — kernel, networking, performance tuning, package management.

Container expertise: Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm chart authoring.

Kubernetes Topology: leverage Taints and tolerations, Aﬃnities, Topology Spreads to build reliable systems.

 

Automation & CI/CD:

Strong scripting skills in Bash and at least one general-purpose language (Python preferred).

Experience with CI/CD platforms: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or CircleCI.

Source control mastery: Git (GitHub), branching strategies, code review workﬂows, GitOps.

Experience authoring reliable automation pipelines: from regular scripting to orchestration workﬂows using tools such as GitHub Actions or Step Function.

 

Observability & Security:

Hands-on experience with conﬁguring monitoring/logging stacks: Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, and CloudWatch.

Nginx conﬁguration, SSL/TLS management, and certiﬁcate lifecycle automation.

VPN implementation: OpenVPN.

Zero Trust Implementation: Cloudﬂare Tunnels.

Familiarity with cloud security best practices: IAM least-privilege, secrets management (Vault / AWS Secrets Manager), network segmentation.

Experience with Containers and Kubernetes security: Network Policies, RBAC, Logs and events auditing, containers hardening, Seccomp.

 

Data & Middleware:

Experience supporting relational databases (PostgreSQL), caches (Redis, Memcache), and message buses (Kafka/RedPanda, RabbitMQ), NoSQL Databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB).

Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, CDN.

 

AI Fluency:

You actively use AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) as part of your daily workﬂow - not occasionally.

You have applied LLMs or AI tooling to infrastructure problems: incident summarization, code generation, IaC linting, runbook drafting.

You understand the limitations of AI-generated infrastructure code and apply critical review before shipping to production.

Curiosity about where AIOps, LLMOps, and platform engineering are heading — and excitement to help Novo get there ﬁrst.



Novo values diversity as a core tenant of the work we do and the businesses we serve. We are an equal opportunity employer, indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, role-specific, or any other protected characteristic.
